criteria.text: permission.asked renders an approve/deny prompt in the session view.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c1: exact permission.asked contract renders an actionable prompt

criteria.text: A session blocked on a permission shows a waiting on you badge/state clearly distinct from working.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c2: permission-blocked session row says Waiting on you instead of working

criteria.text: Approve replies with response once or always and deny replies with response reject through POST /agent-sessions/:id/permissions/:permissionID/reply.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c3: permission replies use the exact REST fallback contract

criteria.text: Opening a session hydrates pre-existing asks from GET /agent-sessions/:id/pending-permissions.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c4: selecting a session hydrates pre-existing pending permissions

criteria.text: permission.replied removes the matching prompt from desktop state.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c5: exact permission.replied contract resolves the matching ask
